name: Once Upon a Scheme
source:
Three fairy tale princes need your help to pull off a legendary heist. Will you find your way back home, or remain lost forever?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
三位童话王子需要你的协助，来干一票足以载入传说的惊天大劫案。你最终能否找到重返故乡的路，还是会永远迷失在童话世界里？

[摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用[/url]]
